title: ACTUAL SIZE
description: Left: the name and three nav links, the claim in a condensed display face as the largest text, a role line, a three-row proof table (care platform rebuild at Vianova since 2026, bayyinahtv.com, Viva Fresh in both stores) and one action. Right: the care platform's real claims screen at actual size in a framed window, under a drawing-style dimension line that reads 'Actual size: 782 of 1440 pixels across'.
signature: Type: Hubot Sans (local 'Gentrit Display') at width 80, weight 740 for the claim (64 px desktop, 36 px phone), results and headings; Mona Sans ('Gentrit Text') 15–19 px for text; IBM Plex Mono ('Gentrit Technical Mono') 12.5 px for captions, labels, years and the dimension lines, tabular. Colour, all from the care app: ground #f5f7fb (its own ground), ink oklch(0.25 0.04 235) (its dark teal toward black), one accent #01698f (its primary button: links, the action, focus), one red mark #c81e25 (its current-time line) meaning 'now'. The visible rule: every screen sits under a dimension line, as on a drawing at 1:1, measured live ('782 of 1440 pixels across'). Motion: a quiet layer (press 120 ms, underline 150 ms, instant focus); the one moment is the tile-to-case View Transition, 520 ms in-out (0.77, 0, 0.175, 1): the window and its dimension line grow from the home crop to the whole 1440-pixel app while no pixel scales, and the line's label turns into 'all 1440 pixels across'.
rule: The page is a window onto the real apps at actual size: every screen is cut to the part that proves its line, never shrunk, and opening a case only opens the window wider.
designRead: Reading this as: a frontend and mobile developer, now full stack, for a hiring manager with two minutes, leading with the care platform rebuild, in a page where every product screen is shown at actual size.
hook: The one where every app screen is shown at its real size under a measuring line ('782 of 1440 pixels'), and opening the case stretches the line and the window to the whole app without zooming.
lead: The care platform rebuild (Vianova, 2023–26): the largest checkable change for a hiring manager (a live app moving to React screen by screen while care teams keep using it; one billing report from 16 database requests to 2), with real screens at 2× that stay readable at actual size.
composition: first-screen.md #1, sentence + proof row + one screen, decided by the rule: a 1:1 screen cannot fit, so the window shows a measured part of it (782 of 1440 pixels) and says so on a dimension line; the words get a narrow column, which is why the display face is condensed. The phone row keeps the right-hand column with one tall and two short phone screens at phone width.

fourAnswers.desktop: Gentrit Rashiti (first words of the 64 px claim) / web and phone apps; frontend and mobile developer since 2021, now full stack, remote from Kosovo / care teams, learners and shoppers / the care platform's real claims screen at actual size on 49% of the screen, under 'Actual size: 782 of 1440 pixels across', plus a proof table: care platform rebuild at Vianova since 2026, bayyinahtv.com, Viva Fresh on the App Store and Google Play (all linked)
fourAnswers.phone: Gentrit Rashiti (claim, 4 lines at 36 px) / web and phone apps, role line under it / care teams, learners and shoppers / the dimension line and the claims screen at actual size from y ≈ 340 (Claims Management, the update banner, Draft 7), the owner's caption right under it, then the proof table with the live and store links

allowed: C08c: phone app screens are drawn at real phone width (390 px), so a store listing file holds about 1.55x, not 2x
check.note: The live measurements are marked data-measured, so T45 no longer needs an allow.

holdback: Original and hook, 8 at best: the dimension line now makes the rule readable in a still, but the skeleton is still the standard split (claim left, screen right), and the transition is a quiet 520 ms that a reviewer may still read as a fast navigation. A fresh reviewer may hold original at 7.
skillNotes: Helped: (1) work-display.md's 'never larger than its pixels; crop, do not shrink; 1:1' was enough to seed the whole rule, and first-screen.md's element table plus the phone rules made the first screen a checklist. (2) writing.md's work-in-progress pattern ('Care teams keep using the app while each screen moves over' + a witnessed proof line) fit the owner rule that 16 → 2 is a proof line, and the word table (query → database request) kept tech words off the home. (3) motion.md's build order (end state first, then cause, then motion, then reduced motion) and the tile-to-case recipe. (4) The checker caught real bugs: my reset `.x h1 {margin:0}` outranked single-class role selectors; the host's @layer base set h1–h4 to Archivo at stretch 112%, so my h3s silently became a fourth family (T18b); 'CV' and inline links under 24 px; 'Services' and 'runtime'. Unclear, wrong or missing: (a) snippets/view-transition.css scales the snapshots (group resize + 100%-width images), which zooms screenshot text; the skill forbids text blur but never shows the no-scale variant: set inline-size/block-size in px on ::view-transition-old/new, overflow:hidden on the image pair, and translate both by the crop-offset difference. It also omits: the name must be on both elements in CSS (the var() sketch needs an inline style), await img.decode() inside the update callback, fall back to a cross-fade when the source tile is off screen, and move focus to the new h1 after the route change. (b) Hard rule 9 says keyboard actions do not animate, while the quiet layer animates 'opening a case'; say whether Enter on a case link animates (I skipped it when event.detail === 0). (c) 'Original or hook ≤ 7 → go back to direct' conflicts with a professional band asked to use the standard first-screen pattern; the skill needs a line on where originality may live inside that pattern (scale, crop, type, one transition). (d) Phone screenshots: 'text ≥ 11 px' and '2× density' conflict for store-listing frames (390 px wide gives 1.55×, 2× gives ~10.8 px text); say which wins. (e) Checker: an inside an overflow:hidden crop window is measured by its full rect, so a below-fold window raised C16c (lazy first-screen image) and inflates C01 unless the window carries data-work; clip rects to the nearest clipping ancestor or document 'mark crop windows with data-work'. T45 has no marker for computed numbers (a live '825 of 1440 pixels' readout needs an allow); a data-measured marker would help. T10b read the app-screen name 'Home' in a phone caption as nav microcopy. The checker changed four times during the round (--owner/--facts first ignored, --list missing, checks.md appearing, C02 phone budget 70 → 90, T12c/T23 rules rewritten), so verdicts moved under unchanged pages. (f) Fonts: neither 'swap with a metric fallback' nor 'optional' works for a condensed display face on a cold headless run (optional keeps the fallback in every capture; swap reflows a 4-line claim). Gating the first render on document.fonts.load with a 700 ms cap gave CLS 0; the skill could offer that pattern. (g) The case template's facts row 'Role · Years · Platforms · Live' has three middots, which T30 flags; a dl is the safer default and the template should say so. Polish pass (after review): the new writing.md work-in-progress rule and the team-credit rule would have prevented the two worst copy errors; the new view-transition snippet's object-fit:none variant only covers a crop that widens from the same corner, so a crop that also moves still needs the translate keyframes. checks.md now documents data-measured, which removed the T45 allow.
polish: Facts: the care rebuild is no longer written as live. Home row: 'Being rebuilt in React, one tested screen at a time.' plus 'Each screen must pass the same test on the old and the new app. None is live yet; care teams use the Vue app.' Case lede, Live cell, result ('The result so far'), In short and the engineers' trade-off now say no React screen is live; 'both run until the move is done' is gone.
Facts: the Now row reads 'Care platform rebuild at Vianova, since 2026' (React rebuild 2026, Vue app 2023–26 per CONTENT §7b); the care row and case kicker give both years.
Facts: Design System v2 row kept in the owner's wording (team effort on a foundation Gentrit laid).
Facts: the AI line is verbatim in About (context moved to its own sentence) and said once on the case; the duplicate scope sentence in 'The product' is gone.

Facts (owner rule 3): Dukagjini's home screen with its 'over half a million titles' banner replaced by its Foreign Books list, cropped below the search field; no product marketing number is on the page.

Facts: the hero screen is now the claims screen (claims are in CONTENT's built list) instead of the calendar; the case hero and the transition use the same screen; the calendar and overview screens are no longer shown.
Gate: checker PASS on home and case, 0 warnings; the unused T23 and T45 allows were removed.

Clarity: the rule reads at rest. Every screen sits under a dimension line with end ticks, measured live ('Actual size: 782 of 1440 pixels across'; 'all 780 pixels' for the date picker; 'Phone size: 390 pixels across'); captions now only say what the screen is plus 'Real product screens, invented data.'; the colophon sentence about sizes is gone.

Clarity: the duplicate 'Case' nav link removed; links to /work/ pages say 'Case, on the main site'; the case numbers row keeps '16 → 2' and 'Sept 2026' (same test passed on both apps, not live yet) and drops 36 and 4; the flow is one line of five words with one return arrow, no boxes; About now gives dated lines (phone since 2021, web since 2023, the care platform's server since 2026, UBT); role line says 'since 2021'; the Bayyinah row adds its 34 pages.

Phone: hero crop shows Claims Management, the update banner and Draft 7 (no patient names), with the caption directly under the screen inside the first screen; the case hero now starts at y ≈ 485 (facts move under the screen on phones); the glucose crop shows the curve, not empty grid; the visible-width maths clamps to the viewport (no more '407 of 1440' when 390 are visible); 'See the whole screen' opens fitted to the phone with an 'Actual size' toggle, and actual size by default on wide screens.

Craft: windows end at the gutter with a hairline frame instead of bleeding off the right edge (782 px, ending on a gap between cards); the phone row is one tall screen and two short ones in the right-hand column instead of three equal frames; the transition is 520 ms in-out so the window visibly travels, and the dimension line is a second shared element that grows with it; coming back (link or browser Back) restores the row the visitor left, and the shared screen only animates when it is in view.
